sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal, ultra-sparse Mixture-of-Experts model. It has 125B parameters, including an additional 51B N-gram embedding table, while activating 6B parameters per token. The architecture combines four main ideas: GDN + QSA: three of every four layers use Gated DeltaNet to compress history; the fourth uses Qwen Sparse Attention for precise long-range retrieval ...

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: Day-0 Support in SGLang - LMSYS Org
sources.snippet: An NVFP4 checkpoint we quantized: RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4, released day-0. N-Gram Embedding: offloading the N-gram embedding to host memory greatly reduces GPU memory usage, and asynchronous prefetching overlaps it with model computation at almost no extra cost.
